settings.question: What is LINE?
settings.answer: LINE is a brand specializing in curating innovative solutions for daily well-being. Our goal is to help you rest better, relieve tension, and feel great through products carefully chosen for their quality, functionality, and design.

settings.question: What type of products do you sell?
settings.answer: At LINE, you will find a selection of products related to wellness, recovery, personal care, rest, posture, relaxation, light fitness, and muscle relief. Every product is evaluated before becoming part of our collection.

settings.question: Do the products have a warranty?
settings.answer: Yes. We work exclusively with products that meet our quality standards. If an item has a manufacturing defect or arrives damaged, our team will help you resolve the issue quickly and easily.

settings.question: Do I need to create an account to buy?
settings.answer: No. You can make your purchase as a guest if you prefer. However, creating a free account will allow you to easily manage your orders, save your favorite products, and access exclusive benefits when available.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Delivery time depends on the destination and the product purchased. In most cases, orders are delivered within an estimated 3 to 7 business days. Once your order has been shipped, you will receive an email with tracking information so you can monitor its progress.

settings.question: How can I track my order?
settings.answer: Once your order is processed and shipped, you will receive an email with your tracking number and instructions to track the shipment. If you have not received this information after the indicated processing time, please contact our customer support team at supports@linecommercial.com.

settings.question: When will I receive my tracking number?
settings.answer: Your tracking number is sent by email once the order has been processed and dispatched. This typically occurs within 1 to 3 business days after confirming your purchase, although during high-demand periods processing may take a little longer.

settings.question: Where is my order?
settings.answer:
Once you complete your purchase, you will receive a confirmation email with your order details and a tracking number. You can use that number in the Track Order section of our website to follow your shipment in real time.

During the early stages it is normal for the status to show messages such as "Order registered" or "Awaiting carrier" — this means your order has been confirmed and the supplier is preparing the package for pickup.

Once the carrier receives the package, the status will update to "In transit" or similar. In some cases, the first tracking updates may take 24 to 72 hours to appear, depending on processing times and the assigned carrier.

If after that period you still cannot see information about your order, please contact us at supports@linecommercial.com.

settings.question: Which countries do you ship to?
settings.answer: We currently ship primarily within the United States. Depending on the product and supplier availability, some items may be shipped to other countries. If you have questions about a specific destination, please contact us before placing your order.

settings.question: Can I modify or cancel my order?
settings.answer: If your order has not yet been processed for shipment, modifications or cancellations may be possible. We recommend contacting us as soon as possible at supports@linecommercial.com. Once the order has been shipped, we cannot guarantee changes or cancellations.

settings.question: What should I do if I entered an incorrect shipping address?
settings.answer:
If you notice that you entered an incorrect or incomplete address, please contact us as soon as possible at supports@linecommercial.com. If your order has not yet been processed or shipped, we will do our best to update the delivery address at no additional cost.

Once the order has been processed or dispatched, we cannot guarantee address changes. Line Commercial will not be responsible for delays, losses, or failed deliveries caused by incorrect shipping information provided at the time of purchase.

settings.question: What should I do if my order arrives damaged?
settings.answer:
We apologize for any inconvenience. If your order arrives damaged or has an issue, please contact us within 14 days of delivery by emailing supports@linecommercial.com. Please include:

- Your order number.
- Clear photographs of the product.
- Photographs of the packaging.
- A brief description of the problem.

Our team will review your case and offer a solution as soon as possible.

settings.question: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer:
We accept the main payment methods to offer a secure and convenient shopping experience, including:

- Visa
- Mastercard
- American Express
- PayPal
- Other payment methods available at checkout.

All payments are processed through secure platforms with encryption technology to protect your information.

settings.question: Can I return a product?
settings.answer: Yes. If you are not completely satisfied with your purchase, you may request a return in accordance with our Refund and Returns Policy. We recommend reviewing that policy to understand the applicable requirements, deadlines, and conditions.

settings.question: How can I contact customer support?
settings.answer:
Our customer support team is available to help you.

Email: supports@linecommercial.com
Monday – Friday: 9:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. ET
Saturday: 9:00 a.m. – 2:00 p.m. ET

We strive to respond to all inquiries within 24 to 48 business hours.
